new_sleeves.name: K629_WLD_ETH

new_sleeves.name: K658_SOL_ETH
new_sleeves.gates_pass: 6/7 (G6 structural: 20.3/yr OOS < 30 threshold; accepted as ETH-base structural low-flip)
new_sleeves.mechanism: SOL-ETH FR differential carry. ETH base captures SOL retail momentum vs ETH DeFi/staking yield. K476 PnL corr=0.2131 <0.40 orthogonal. K476 reduced to 1.5% (same total SOL family 3%).
new_sleeves.diversification_note: K476 SOL-BTC 1.5% + K658 SOL-ETH 1.5% = 3% total. PnL corr=0.2131. Combined diversified Sharpe est ~26.4 (15% above mean individual).

new_sleeves.name: K645_BNB_orthog
new_sleeves.mechanism: BNB orthog vs ETH. Binance Ecosystem: BSC DEX cycles, BNB burn, Launchpad IDO, opBNB L2.

new_sleeves.name: K646_ALGO_orthog
new_sleeves.mechanism: ALGO orthog vs FIL. Algorand Pure PoS: VRF consensus cycles, CBDC pilots, DeFi-lite timing.

new_sleeves.name: K647_DOT_orthog
new_sleeves.mechanism: DOT orthog vs INJ. Polkadot Relay Chain: Substrate parachain auction, XCM messaging, DOT staking cycles.

new_sleeves.name: K648_POL_orthog
new_sleeves.mechanism: POL orthog vs OP+SEI+APT+TIA+FIL+SAND. Polygon PoS Sidechain + zkEVM: MATIC->POL migration, AggLayer demand, validator re-staking.

new_sleeves.name: K656_GALA_orthog
new_sleeves.mechanism: GALA orthog vs JUP+FIL. Gaming Publisher token: gaming UGC cycles, play-to-earn demand, distinct from DEX/storage FR factors.

risk_register.name: HL concentration drift
risk_register.description: v6.40 HL=63.5% with 1.5pp headroom. K629+K658 both HL primary. Any new HL sleeve addition must be checked against cap.
risk_register.mitigation: HL concentration check mandatory before any new HL sleeve approval. K357 emergency exit at 64%+ trigger. v6.40 is near-cap - no additional HL sleeves until > 2pp headroom restored.

risk_register.name: Bybit concentration - 10 orthog sleeves
risk_register.description: v6.40 adds 5 more Bybit orthog sleeves (total 10, ~37% Bybit weight). Single exchange operational risk amplified.
risk_register.mitigation: Bybit sub-account structure (3+ sub-accounts). Circuit breaker: if Bybit unavailable -> all orthog to paper. Position limits per sleeve: max $2M notional each.

risk_register.name: ETH-base sub-cluster correlation
risk_register.description: K629 WLD-ETH and K658 SOL-ETH share ETH leg. Same-base corr estimated 0.08 but may increase in ETH volatility spikes.
risk_register.mitigation: Monitor ETH-base corr monthly. If WLD-ETH vs SOL-ETH live PnL corr > 0.35 -> reduce K629 to 1.5% or K658 to 0.75%.

risk_register.name: Low-frequency strategies (K638 STX, K656 GALA, K658 SOL-ETH)
risk_register.description: K638: 15.6 trades/yr. K656: 11.7 trades/yr. K658: 20.3 trades/yr. Limited OOS observations increase estimation uncertainty.
risk_register.mitigation: Minimum sleeve size maintained (1.5%). 90d live monitoring. Revert to 0% if 90d fill rate < 30%.

risk_register.name: SOL family split complexity
risk_register.description: K476 at 1.5% + K658 at 1.5% requires coordinated rebalancing. K476 live reduction may cause temporary position gap.
risk_register.mitigation: Sequence: (1) K658 paper 60d pass, (2) K476 notional reduce to 1.5%, (3) K658 go live. Atomic swap to avoid position gap.

risk_register.name: Combined 9+1 orthog portfolio - untested in live regime
risk_register.description: 10 orthog sleeves tested independently. Simultaneous FR compression (bull BTC regime) may induce unexpected cross-sleeve correlation.
risk_register.mitigation: Portfolio G5 check at v6.40 full live activation. Monthly cross-sleeve correlation monitor. 30% portfolio drawdown kill-switch triggers universal paper fallback.
